author: Inside Edition
description: A 30-year-old American tourist was struck by lightning while hiking Sicily’s Mount Etna as it was erupting. The male victim who has not been named by authorities, was on Europe’s most active volcano Sunday when a thunderstorm broke out, Italian media report. The victim was found by firefighters and emergency services in a state of cardiac arrest in a restricted area near the summit. He was flown by helicopter to Cannizzaro Hospital in Catania but was declared dead on arrival.
title: American Tourist Struck by Lightning, Dies While Hiking Up Exploding Mt. Etna

author: Inside Edition
description: An old episode of the NBC comedy "30 Rock" is going viral today, with a joke that is not aging well about Hayden Panetierre. Jane Krakowski's Jenna character delivered the line to Tina Fey's Liz Lemon, "Oh Liz, you had me at 'Hayden Panetierre's dead." In light of Panetierre's passing, the show's dark humor is now making jaws drop. During its seven-season run from 2006 to 2013, "30 Rock" earned 103 Emmy nominations and won outstanding comedy series three times.
title: '30 Rock's' Hayden Panetierre Joke Did Not Age Well

author: Inside Edition
description: There was dramatic testimony at Lindsay Clancy's murder trial on Monday. Massachusetts mom Clancy is accused of killing her three children in 2023, in what she says was a moment of post-partum psychosis. Clancy's mother took the stand, testifying that her daughter told her she was hearing voices telling her to kill her kids. Clancy's former mother-in-law testified today for the defense. Susan Clancy said Lindsay was "begging for help." Inside Edition's Alison Hall has the details.
title: Susan Clancy Says Lindsay Was 'Begging For Help'

author: Inside Edition
description: If you think you're having a bad day at work, an employee at a Fond Du Lac, Wisconsin frozen custard shop would like a word. Carter Sampson was about to pour a sweet mix into a shake maker, when disaster struck, and he found himself wearing the shake mix instead. The unfortunate and messy moment was caught on surveillance camera, and has been going viral. Carter spoke with Inside Edition's Brooke Anderson about his worst day at work.
title: Frozen Custard Shop Worker Spills Sticky Shake Mix All Over Himself

author: Inside Edition
description: Doctors in Sri Lanka claimed a new record after removing a bladder stone roughly the size of a newborn. Doctors successfully excised a 6.8-pound stone during a procedure last leek at Trincomalee General Hospital. It is the largest documented bladder stone ever removed through surgery. It is believed to have been in the patient for between five to 10 years.
title: Doctors Remove Nearly 7-Pound Bladder Stone From Patient

author: Inside Edition
description: Cops say these dogs accidentally led police to a stash of drugs. They're not trained sniffer dogs, but they were found locked in a hot car with no humans around. Vancouver police in Washington state say the pups were distressed, panting and appeared lethargic. The first thing officers did was free the dogs and get them cooled down. They later searched the vehicle and made a shocking discovery. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Free 2 Dogs From Hot Car And Find Drugs In Vehicle

author: Inside Edition
description: Millions of freshly hatched mayflies swarmed the streets of Wilkes Barre, Pennsylvania, attracted by streetlights. Local TV host Chris Bohinski braved the swarm. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian spoke with Bohinski. Mayflies only live for about 24 hours after hatching. When Bohinski returned the next morning, there were millions of dead flies covering the road.
title: Millions Of Mayflies Swarm Streets Of Pennsylvania City
